key_insight: MedPMC is an automated framework that turns PMC medical literature into large, high-fidelity image-text data for training stronger multimodal foundation models.
clinical_relevance: By improving multimodal model performance on medical imaging, VQA, and retrieval, this approach could support more reliable AI tools for clinical and research workflows.
method: Scanned 6.1 million PMC articles for permissively licensed medical figure-caption pairs
Applied automated steps for screening, multi-panel detection, figure/caption separation, alignment, and medical figure classification
Released an updateable corpus, benchmarks, and pretrained models for broader use
evidence_signal: The pipeline produced 11 million image-text pairs and showed strong component performance, with manual review finding 95.3% medically relevant images and downstream gains across 26 benchmarks plus clinical evaluations.
watch_item: Because the corpus is built from literature figures rather than direct patient data, performance may still vary by specialty, imaging type, and real-world deployment setting.
paper_title: MedPMC: A Systematic Framework for Scaling High-Fidelity Medical Multimodal Data for Foundation Models
